svg.title: AgileForge: sequence and loops
svg.desc: Usual progression through grouped stages: Create Project, Vision, Product Goal, Specification registration/structuring/review, Backlog, Roadmap, Stories, Sprint planning and start, Task execution and evidence, Story closure, Sprint review and closure, triage, and assessment of another Sprint. Dashed loops are conditional and preserve history. Live workflow position and next commands determine available actions. This overview omits other revision, Goal outcome and retry branches.

path.title: Use the questions, feedback and revision actions supported by this stage. Prior authorization covers only its scope; changed candidates need review.
Use the questions, feedback and revision actions supported by this stage. Prior authorization covers only its scope; changed candidates need review.

Use the questions, feedback and revision actions supported by this stage. Prior authorization covers only its scope; changed candidates need review.
Use the questions, feedback and revision actions supported by this stage. Prior authorization covers only its scope; changed candidates need review.
Build, verify and fix; repeat for the current Tasks until completion evidence is ready.
Resolve acceptance gaps within authorized Task and Story scope before closure, or report them. This conceptual loop does not reopen completed Tasks or rewrite evidence.

Changed requirements may use an eligible source amendment after completed and triaged delivery, with no active Sprint or retry and no unresolved reviews. Register, structure and review the revision; preserve accepted history.
If continuing with eligible remaining Stories, reuse valid accepted planning under the same Project. Select scope, review readiness and dependencies, then plan, review and start.

g.aria-label: Create Project. Input: Product identity and repository binding. Output: One durable Project. Your input: Missing setup details; an existing instruction to create it remains valid.
g.title: Create Project. Input: Product identity and repository binding. Output: One durable Project. Your input: Missing setup details; an existing instruction to create it remains valid.

g.aria-label: Vision. Input: Project context, users and the problem to solve. Output: Accepted product Vision. Your input: Yes. Clarify direction and approve it.
g.title: Vision. Input: Project context, users and the problem to solve. Output: Accepted product Vision. Your input: Yes. Clarify direction and approve it.

g.aria-label: Product Goal. Input: Vision and priorities. Output: Accepted measurable Goal and success criteria. Your input: Yes. Choose the outcome and what success means.
g.title: Product Goal. Input: Vision and priorities. Output: Accepted measurable Goal and success criteria. Your input: Yes. Choose the outcome and what success means.

g.aria-label: Specification. Input: Accepted Vision and Goal plus exact prepared source bytes. Register the source, structure agileforge.spec.v2, and review the exact candidate. Output: Accepted requirements with immutable lineage. Your input: Source content and candidate acceptance.
g.title: Specification. Input: Accepted Vision and Goal plus exact prepared source bytes. Register the source, structure agileforge.spec.v2, and review the exact candidate. Output: Accepted requirements with immutable lineage. Your input: Source content and candidate acceptance.

g.aria-label: Backlog. Input: Accepted Specification. Output: Accepted product work items. Your input: Yes. Confirm scope and product value.
g.title: Backlog. Input: Accepted Specification. Output: Accepted product work items. Your input: Yes. Confirm scope and product value.

g.aria-label: Roadmap. Input: Backlog, priorities and dependencies. Output: Accepted order of product work. Your input: Yes. Confirm sequencing and tradeoffs.
g.title: Roadmap. Input: Backlog, priorities and dependencies. Output: Accepted order of product work. Your input: Yes. Confirm sequencing and tradeoffs.

g.aria-label: Stories. Input: Accepted Backlog and Roadmap. Output: Reviewed Story content and acceptance criteria. Acceptance alone does not establish Sprint readiness; sizing, rank, structural evidence, selection and dependencies also matter. Your input: Expected behavior and human-owned readiness decisions.
g.title: Stories. Input: Accepted Backlog and Roadmap. Output: Reviewed Story content and acceptance criteria. Acceptance alone does not establish Sprint readiness; sizing, rank, structural evidence, selection and dependencies also matter. Your input: Expected behavior and human-owned readiness decisions.

g.aria-label: Sprint plan and start with Tasks. Input: Selected Stories, readiness evidence, reviewed dependencies and capacity. Output: Accepted plan with Tasks, followed by a separate Sprint start. Your input: Scope, dependencies, capacity, plan acceptance and start.
g.title: Sprint plan and start with Tasks. Input: Selected Stories, readiness evidence, reviewed dependencies and capacity. Output: Accepted plan with Tasks, followed by a separate Sprint start. Your input: Scope, dependencies, capacity, plan acceptance and start.

g.aria-label: Develop and verify. Input: The current Task and accepted Story contract. Output: Implementation, verification, and separately recorded Task completion evidence. Your input: Usually unnecessary within authorized scope; needed for new product or scope decisions.
g.title: Develop and verify. Input: The current Task and accepted Story contract. Output: Implementation, verification, and separately recorded Task completion evidence. Your input: Usually unnecessary within authorized scope; needed for new product or scope decisions.

g.aria-label: Close Stories. Input: Terminal Tasks, exact evidence and Story criteria. Output: Separate closure recording delivered results and known gaps. Story closure may interleave with other Task work. Your input: Confirm closure if not already authorized; readiness to close is not full product acceptance.
g.title: Close Stories. Input: Terminal Tasks, exact evidence and Story criteria. Output: Separate closure recording delivered results and known gaps. Story closure may interleave with other Task work. Your input: Confirm closure if not already authorized; readiness to close is not full product acceptance.

g.aria-label: Review and close Sprint. Input: Terminal Stories and exact delivery evidence. Output: Persisted Sprint review, followed by a separate Sprint closure. Your input: Assess results and authorize review and closure.
g.title: Review and close Sprint. Input: Terminal Stories and exact delivery evidence. Output: Persisted Sprint review, followed by a separate Sprint closure. Your input: Assess results and authorize review and closure.

g.aria-label: Learn and triage. Input: Closed Sprint, feedback and lessons. Output: Recorded learning and impact. Triage does not itself apply follow-up changes or start a Sprint. Your input: Decide impact and intended follow-up.
g.title: Learn and triage. Input: Closed Sprint, feedback and lessons. Output: Recorded learning and impact. Triage does not itself apply follow-up changes or start a Sprint. Your input: Decide impact and intended follow-up.

g.aria-label: Assess next Sprint. Input: Learning, current Goal and eligible remaining work. Output: A continuation decision under the same Project. Another Sprint is conditional; revisions, blockers or optional Goal outcomes may need attention. Your input: Next priority and scope when appropriate.
g.title: Assess next Sprint. Input: Learning, current Goal and eligible remaining work. Output: A continuation decision under the same Project. Another Sprint is conditional; revisions, blockers or optional Goal outcomes may need attention. Your input: Next priority and scope when appropriate.
